title: TECH TRAIL HUNT (E TREASURE HUNT)
rules:
1. Each Team will be given 15 minutes to explore contents of various images given by the organisers in a folder on a system in Computer Lab.
  2. After 15 minutes, each Team will be provided with a set of clues and a Questionnaire. Each Team has to find Answers to the clues & the questionnaire in the given images and notify the correct Image number and the Area/ Object in the Image. Time Limit for this part will be 20 minutes.
  3. Upon completion of 20 minutes every team has to submit their Answers Page.
  4. The team that scores maximum points will be declared as the Winner.
  5. In case of a tie Breaker, another set of Images will be provided to Tie Breaker teams only. Score and Time of Submission will decide the winner.
  6. The decision of organisers will be final and binding to all.
  7. Violation of any rule of the event will lead to disqualification of the Team.
judging:
• Correct Image Number: 10 Points
  • Correct Identification of the Area/Object: 05 Points
